q: Time doesn't heal emotional pain, you need to learn how to let go.
People have a hard time letting go of their suffering. Out of a fear of the unknown, they prefer suffering that is familiar.
When another person makes you suffer, it is because he suffers deeply within himself, and his suffering is spilling over.
There is a crack, a crack in everything. That's how the light gets in.
The only thing worse than a broken heart is knowing you would give him another chance.
The field of consciousness is tiny. It accepts only one problem at a time.
Nature is our mother. Because we live cut off from her, we get sick.
Breath is the bridge which connects life to consciousness, which unites your body to your thoughts.
What we find if we're not used to sitting quietly with ourselves is that we're very threatened by nothing happening.
There is more to life than increasing its speed.
A scar simply means you were stronger than whatever tried to hurt you.
The world breaks every one and afterward many are strong at the broken places.
Somehow if we could learn to not be afraid of groundlessness, not be afraid of insecurity and uncertainty, it would be calling on an inner strength.
Hope is important because it can make the present moment less difficult to bear. If we believe that tomorrow will be better, we can bear a hardship today.
From every wound, there's a scar, and every scar tells a story. A story that says you survived.
Self-compassion entails being warm towards oneself when encountering pain and personal shortcomings, rather than ignoring them or hurting oneself with self-criticism.
Self-compassion is simply giving the same kindness to ourselves that we would give to a good friend.
When you plant lettuce, if it does not grow well, you don't blame the lettuce. You look for reasons it is not doing well.
To be beautiful means to be yourself. You don't need to be accepted by others. You need to accept yourself.
We are very good at preparing to live, but not very good at living.
